items.text: Horse armor overhaul: rider protection removed, horse armor boosted, no speed penalty, heavy plates allowed, stamina drain added, and road signs gain 12 storage slots.
Helicopter handling improvements: smoother mounted input sequencing, fixed client ticking and bounce bugs for predicted helicopters at high latency.
Seamless vehicle clustering: nearby vehicles and players are grouped into server clusters, staying on a single server for consistent behavior.
Main inventory size on the extraction map halved, tightening looting decisions.
Item UI now shows scrap value, letting you see loot worth at a glance.
Cargo ship loot pools rebalanced: containers now contain only tools, ammo/meds, or food, removing high‑tier weapons.
Buildings placed near each other automatically merge into a single base, simplifying expansion.
Seamless servers now share a unified time of day, spawn full enemy waves beyond terrain borders, and allow shooting across server boundaries.
Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting, preventing accidental placement interruptions.
Expanded NPC services: profession‑based name tags, voice mumbling, full kiosks with attendants for armour, restoration, and a new giga‑furnace drop‑off at Bandit Camp.

Residents receive free meals in apartments and can refill food levels to 80% at canteen NPCs; all services are accessed via dedicated UI panels and now work reliably for all players.
New 40 mm Tracker Round grenade attaches to surfaces and creates a 5‑minute tracking marker on the map.
Outpost location added to the extraction map, safe pocket indicator appears when accessing loot containers, and FPV drone UI now includes an artificial horizon showing pitch and roll.

Added full FPV drone camera effects and HUD override support, enhancing drone piloting experience.

- Helicopter handling improvements: smoother mounted input sequencing, fixed client ticking and bounce bugs for predicted helicopters at high latency.
- Seamless vehicle clustering: nearby vehicles and players are grouped into server clusters, staying on a single server for consistent behavior.

### Inventory, Loot & Economy

- Item UI now shows scrap value, letting you see loot worth at a glance.
- Cargo ship loot pools rebalanced: containers now contain only tools, ammo/meds, or food, removing high‑tier weapons.

### Base Building & World Interaction
- Buildings placed near each other automatically merge into a single base, simplifying expansion.
- Seamless servers now share a unified time of day, spawn full enemy waves beyond terrain borders, and allow shooting across server boundaries.
- Players can no longer deploy structures while crafting, preventing accidental placement interruptions.

- Expanded NPC services: profession‑based name tags, voice mumbling, full kiosks with attendants for armour, restoration, and a new giga‑furnace drop‑off at Bandit Camp.

- Residents receive free meals in apartments and can refill food levels to 80% at canteen NPCs; all services are accessed via dedicated UI panels and now work reliably for all players.

### New Gear

### UI & Map Enhancements
- Outpost location added to the extraction map, safe pocket indicator appears when accessing loot containers, and FPV drone UI now includes an artificial horizon showing pitch and roll.

### Gameplay & Features
- Fixed brief island disappearance when switching seamless servers, removing a visual glitch.
- Added full FPV drone camera effects and HUD override support, enhancing drone piloting experience.
- Enabled operating the giga furnace from a walk‑in counter and corrected booth counter displays, improving base management.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Giga Furnace is now located inside Bandit Camps, letting players use its crafting benefits within those zones.

items.text: Turret weapons now take damage when firing and can break, shutting off their laser and sparking.
A reload progress bar is displayed beside the weapon in shoulder‑camera view.

Grenade updates – 40 mm flare now uses road flare VFX, appears white, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground; 40 mm incendiary grenade receives new visual and sound effects, an updated icon, and rebalanced damage.
Scientists now correctly flank targets, fixing previous failures.
Extraction maps expanded with additional monuments and a new 3 km procedural map scene for raids.
Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash and raiders are spawned at raid start.
New shipping containers can spawn on mainland coasts (jungle, arctic, desert); they require lock‑breaking to open, are rare (~1 per 100 players), and contain unique loot.
Tool cupboards now fill resources evenly, similar to furnaces, improving resource balance.
CCTV recordings now handle player death or dismount events without crashing playback.
Added a deployable trampoline prototype for players to place and use.
Added a “clear customisation” action for skinned arrows and introduced a deployable fletching jig (arrow customization station).
Introduced a new FPV drone and goggles system, with script fixes for SetFlag behavior and null reference errors.

Cargo containers are now codelocked; breaking them requires 1.5× the damage of a timed satchel, health UI appears only when looking at the lock, doors cannot be destroyed and must be opened after unlocking; one container includes a code note.
Conveyor belts now move up to 24 items per tick, increasing throughput.
Scrolling panels no longer flicker, providing a stable UI view while moving through inventories or menus.
Previously invisible building blocks are now visible, ensuring structures can be placed and seen correctly.

2026-11-10.summary:
### Combat & Weapon Systems

- Grenade updates – 40 mm flare now uses road flare VFX, appears white, and self‑destructs if shot into the ground; 40 mm incendiary grenade receives new visual and sound effects, an updated icon, and rebalanced damage.

### AI & NPC Behavior
- Scientists now correctly flank targets, fixing previous failures.

### Raids & Extraction
- Extraction maps expanded with additional monuments and a new 3 km procedural map scene for raids.
- Extracted loot is automatically banked in a stash and raiders are spawned at raid start.

### World & Loot
- New shipping containers can spawn on mainland coasts (jungle, arctic, desert); they require lock‑breaking to open, are rare (~1 per 100 players), and contain unique loot.
- Tool cupboards now fill resources evenly, similar to furnaces, improving resource balance.
- CCTV recordings now handle player death or dismount events without crashing playback.

### Deployables & Crafting
- Added a deployable trampoline prototype for players to place and use.
- Added a “clear customisation” action for skinned arrows and introduced a deployable fletching jig (arrow customization station).
- Introduced a new FPV drone and goggles system, with script fixes for SetFlag behavior and null reference errors.

- Cargo containers are now codelocked; breaking them requires 1.5× the damage of a timed satchel, health UI appears only when looking at the lock, doors cannot be destroyed and must be opened after unlocking; one container includes a code note.
